name: backend

scripts.predev: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const { existsSync } = require('fs'); if (!existsSync('venv')) { console.log('⚙️ Membuat virtual environment (venv)...'); execSync('python3 -m venv venv', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } console.log('📦 Memeriksa & memasang dependensi Python...'); execSync('venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip tensorflow numpy opencv-python', { stdio: 'inherit' });"

description: Backend Express.js TypeScript untuk pengenalan ekspresi FER-2013 dengan ensemble TensorFlow.js & Prisma ORM
